scope: Read-only archived documentation and source-contract review; no provider calls, credentials, code changes, full suite, Git writes or acceptance execution.

primary_findings.quote: all: Return transactions that reference either the provided address or any token account owned by the provided address
primary_findings.result: Documents an owned-token query predicate. Does not explicitly define former/closed/reassigned/event-time ownership or both token programs.

quotes: This method is unique because it can query complete token history, including a wallet's associated token accounts (ATAs).
The tokenAccounts filter does not support transactions prior to December 2022. It depends on token transfer metadata introduced to Solana on slot 111,491,819.
primary_findings.result: Broad complete-history advertisement plus a concrete cutoff; neither alone establishes exact historical membership semantics for hidden transient accounts.

The pre-cutoff workaround discovers accounts from direct wallet records. Its spl-token-2022 program check is not a documented post-cutoff both-program index completeness guarantee. A hidden entirely unreferenced account can evade direct-wallet discovery.

primary_findings.quote: If omitted, only legacy transactions will be returned. Set to 1 to include legacy, v0, and v1 transactions.
primary_findings.result: A terminal max0 query covers its admitted-format predicate. Native legacy/v0 support cannot itself certify absence of all relevant unsupported versions; preserve this population dependency.

primary_findings.quote: A completely hidden round trip can leave zero residual mismatch. Mark that scope limitation explicitly; require independent historical ownership evidence before a global completeness claim.
primary_findings.result: Current owner snapshots, direct-address history, repeated/fixed-point discovery, exact balance reconciliation and apparent first wallet funding are insufficient population witnesses.

InitializeAccount2/3 owner and SetAuthority new_authority come from decoded instruction payload. Initialization can assign a wallet as token owner without that owner appearing in message account keys; an exhaustive direct-wallet account-key history cannot exclude those initially hidden accounts. This is a native schema counterexample, not a new application defect.

concrete_source_decision.endpoint_access: Previously empirically observed for the bounded calls; not repeated by this review.
concrete_source_decision.query_completion: May become known from immutable native request/response page chains satisfying exact bounded query contract, independent of global population.
concrete_source_decision.historical_population: UNKNOWN under current documented semantics and existing inputs. Do not activate trusted completion flags or a built-in global PASS contract from these pages.
concrete_source_decision.missing_exact_source_capability: An independently supported exhaustive historical token-account membership/lifecycle witness for closed, reassigned, transient/non-ATA accounts and both token programs, plus relevant format coverage.
concrete_source_decision.finite_alternative: Contemporaneous complete finalized account-state anchors for both programs and a complete finalized global block inventory/replay over the interval, inspecting ownership initialization/change/closure and all relevant supported/unsupported operations. This can prove a finite interval under stated source trust. No such past anchors or feasible complete 90-day replay is present; current snapshots and bounded indexed pages cannot substitute.
concrete_source_decision.controlled_checks: Genuine independently known closed/reassigned/non-ATA/Token2022 examples can test provider compatibility, but do not mathematically establish global enumeration by themselves. Only combine them with an explicitly supported source membership contract.

independent_ledger_method.numbers: Keep raw units and lamports as integers. Use independently implemented Fraction arithmetic for FIFO proportional basis; convert lamports/1e9 only for display. Never use float or scanner decoder/analyze as the oracle.
independent_ledger_method.chronology: Canonical native slot/block/instruction order; UTC timestamps govern half-open membership. Signature lexical order and caller order are not primary chronology.
independent_ledger_method.reconciliation: For each event-time-owned account/mint, opening + inflows - outflows = closing; then aggregate all historically owned accounts by mint. Internal transfer cancels only with proved ownership at both ends. Reconciliation is not enumeration proof.
independent_ledger_method.fifo: Each acquisition lot carries raw units and proved consideration plus attributable buy cost. For a partial lot removal take basis*removed_units/current_lot_units and retain exact remaining basis; final removal takes the entire remaining basis. Missing acquisition cost revokes dependent disposals.
independent_ledger_method.disposals: Net disposal = proved proceeds - matched FIFO basis - attributable exit costs. Keep distinct swaps and all losing/breakeven/open/transfer-interrupted/unknown episodes. Transfer out is not a sale; unproved transfer-in basis is unknown.
independent_ledger_method.cost_once: Buy cost capitalized; exit cost deducted; remaining actual wallet-paid trading costs deducted once in their own time interval, including failed transaction costs. meta.fee already includes priority; embedded venue costs already in consideration are not deducted twice. Sponsored network fees do not automatically become wallet spend; any reimbursement requires its own role evidence. Refundable rent and wrap/unwrap are not automatic expense.
independent_ledger_method.realised_period: Sum in-window net disposal slices minus in-window unallocated trading overhead. Realised ROI = this profit / positive disposed basis *100.
independent_ledger_method.completed_cohort: Mint aggregate strict-zero episodes whose final economic sale falls in the interval. Hold = first acquisition to final sale. ROI uses whole episode; win numerator is net-positive episodes, denominator includes breakeven. Unknown eligible episodes may not be removed to improve denominators.
independent_ledger_method.other_metrics: Distinct eligible traded mints in report interval; rapid share first positive sale <=5 minutes; average event buys/sells per completed episode; largest positive aggregate mint realised contribution / positive total net period profit. If denominator is zero/nonpositive, ratio is undefined rather than invented zero.
independent_ledger_method.weekly: Four consecutive independent seven-day half-open periods over [end-28d,end). For each independently sum disposal slices, matched basis/exit costs and that week overhead; positive iff >0. Do not crop to a shorter display/report interval.
independent_ledger_method.economic: Closing equity - opening equity - valued external deposits + valued external withdrawals. Costs already reflected in equity changes are not subtracted again. Unavailable marks block this branch, not proved realised-only arithmetic.

retain_if_independent: quantity/holding/cohort measures not using that mark
supported individual raw quantities/consideration and named-account observations

revoke: only results whose source content, ordering, membership or coverage is unresolved
retain_if_independent: independent exact native fees when their own prerequisites remain

retain_if_independent: economic equity if its independent valuation/flow contract remains complete

dependency_removal_expectations.expect: Reproduce original supported observations/decisions in a new immutable report; do not mutate original parent or use provider calls.

acceptance_limits.genuine_b3: A losing wallet or policy MISS is valid once a complete supported genuine wallet accounting scope and independently worked calculations are proven. Economic-only unknowns can remain explicit if that result is excluded from the supported coverage claim; this does not qualify the strict preset or establish full product readiness.
not_b3: Failed-fee-only known observations without exhaustive membership and relevant cost roles
acceptance_limits.current_status: B1 historical completeness unresolved; complete real B2 open; B3 blocked; PRODUCT_READY remains false. This artifact is preparatory independent review, not application or product acceptance.
